URL: https://commonslibrary.parliament.uk/research-briefings/cbp-10590/
(Search snippet content — House of Commons Library, small-boat Channel crossings briefing, 2026)

Around 36,000 people arrived by small boat in the year ending 31 May 2026, 13% fewer than in the same period the year before. Small-boat arrivals made up around 90% of all people detected arriving in the UK without authorisation. Around 75% of those arriving were adult men, 12% adult women and 13% children. Numbers peaked at around 46,000 in 2022, fell in 2023, then rose again to around 41,000 in 2025. Almost all who arrive by this route go on to claim asylum.
